title: Advancing the Pareto Frontier of Test-Time Scaling with Multi-Path Plan Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2510.11620v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Test-time scaling seeks to improve reasoning through additional inference-time computation, commonly using solution sampling with majority voting to select the final answer. However, repeated sampling can reproduce correlated errors, limiting the accuracy gains from additional computation. We introduce Multi-Path Plan Aggregation (MPPA), which learns planning and answer selection using separate LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. The planner jointly generates $K$ short plans, each guiding a separate solution generated by the frozen executor; the aggregator then scores the resulting solutions and selects the final answer. Joint planning encourages complementary approaches suited to the executor's capabilities, while learned selection uses reasoning evidence to identify correct candidates. Alternating optimization improves planning and aggregation through supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning. Across five mathematics

translated_title: 通过多路径规划聚合推进测试时扩展的帕累托前沿
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展旨在通过额外的推理时计算来提升推理能力，通常采用解采样结合多数投票的方式来选择最终答案。然而，重复采样可能重现相关联的错误，限制了额外计算带来的准确性收益。我们提出了多路径规划聚合（MPPA），它在共享的冻结主干上使用独立的 LoRA 适配器来学习规划与答案选择。规划器联合生成 K 个简短规划，每个规划指导由冻结执行器生成的一个独立解；随后聚合器对这些解进行评分并选出最终答案。联合规划鼓励与执行器能力相匹配的互补性方法，而学习到的选择机制则利用推理证据来识别正确的候选解。交替优化通过监督微调和强化学习来改进规划与聚合。在五个数学（基准上……摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出多路径规划聚合方法 MPPA，在冻结主干上通过独立 LoRA 适配器学习联合规划与答案选择，生成互补的多路径规划以引导多样化求解并智能评分选优，从而推进测试时扩展的帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Multi-Path Plan Aggregation (MPPA), which learns joint planning and answer selection via separate LoRA adapters on a frozen backbone, generating complementary plans to guide diverse solutions and scoring them to select the final answer, thereby advancing the Pareto frontier of test-time scaling.
